correctness.rationale: Independently decomposed the real Hermitian frame by the four sign characters. Write Q=sum |v_i|^4 and U=(a conjugate(b))^2+(b conjugate(c))^2+(c conjugate(a))^2. The diagonal block is a circulant with diagonal 4Q and off-diagonal 2(1-Q), hence eigenvalues 4, 6Q−2, 6Q−2. Each oriented off-diagonal coordinate pair has a real two-by-two block equal to eight times the sum of the three real-imaginary outer products of a conjugate(b), b conjugate(c), c conjugate(a); the two eigenvalues are 2(1−Q) ± 4|U| in each of the three blocks. The trace is twelve and the scalar eigenvalue is four. Thus lower-frame equality or singular-value condition-number equality forces all eight other eigenvalues to be one, equivalent to Q=1/2 and U=0, also for zero coordinates. At the given seed the squared moduli are 2/3,1/6,1/6 and the real part of the square of either small coordinate is −1/48, giving U=0. Pairing the second moment against X tensor Y verifies the equivalence to S(X)=X+tr(X)I. The sum of all intensities is 4tr(X), giving the 1/16 correction. The only divisor of twelve compatible with spanning nine Hermitian dimensions is twelve; real seeds miss all imaginary-skew directions. Inspected check_a4.py and VERIFICATION.md; the recorded symbolic run was not rerun. The proof above is not limited to the script's seeds.
